desc: The Frigidaire 24-inch built-in dishwasher brings the best features to your home kitchen. Get a thorough clean every time with the BladeSpray arm.
hl: Unlike traditional spray arms, our BladeSpray® arm rotates in two directions, so you get better water coverage that reaches every corner.
Save time loading and unloading and fit more with a third level rack that easily fits silverware, cooking utensils and tools.
With the fan assisted EvenDry™ system, air flow is evenly circulated and moisture is removed for clean, spot-free dishes every time.
Sanitize option removes 99.9% of common household bacteria.
Clean even your largest dishes and bakeware with an adjustable upper level rack that lets you fit more in the bottom rack.
So quiet your dishwasher won't disturb you, even if you run it while you're in the room--runs at 49 dBA.
